# Text conversion

Converting between code pages and UTF-16.

<h2 id="multi-byte-to-wide-char"><code>MultiByteToWideChar</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func MultiByteToWideChar(codePage: CodePage, flags: uint32, multiByteStr: *char8, multiByte: int32, wideCharStr: *char16, wideChar: int32) -> int32
pub extern func MultiByteToWideChar(codePage: uint32, flags: uint32, multiByteStr: *char8, multiByte: int32, wideCharStr: *char16, wideChar: int32) -> int32
```

Maps a character string to a UTF-16 wide character string.

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/stringapiset/nf-stringapiset-multibytetowidechar](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/stringapiset/nf-stringapiset-multibytetowidechar)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/Kernel.rux#L295)

**Parameters**

| Name           | Type                  | Description                                                                            |
| -------------- | --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `codePage`     | `CodePage` / `uint32` | the code page to convert through, as a [`CodePage`](/docs/api/windows/code-page) value |
| `flags`        | `uint32`              | the call's flag bits, combined with `\|`                                               |
| `multiByteStr` | `*char8`              | the bytes to convert                                                                   |
| `multiByte`    | `int32`               | how many bytes, or -1 to stop at the terminator                                        |
| `wideCharStr`  | `*char16`             | receives the UTF-16 units, or null to ask how many are needed                          |
| `wideChar`     | `int32`               | how many units the output holds, or zero to ask                                        |

**Returns**: the units written, the units needed when asked, or zero on failure

<h2 id="wide-char-to-multi-byte"><code>WideCharToMultiByte</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func WideCharToMultiByte(codePage: uint32, flags: uint32, wideCharStr: *char16, wideChar: int32, multiByteStr: *char8, multiByte: int32, defaultChar: *char8, usedDefaultChar: *bool32) -> int32
```

Converts UTF-16 text to another code page.

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/stringapiset/nf-stringapiset-widechartomultibyte](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/stringapiset/nf-stringapiset-widechartomultibyte)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/Kernel.rux#L483)

**Parameters**

| Name              | Type      | Description                                                                            |
| ----------------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `codePage`        | `uint32`  | the code page to convert through, as a [`CodePage`](/docs/api/windows/code-page) value |
| `flags`           | `uint32`  | the call's flag bits, combined with `\|`                                               |
| `wideCharStr`     | `*char16` | receives the UTF-16 units, or null to ask how many are needed                          |
| `wideChar`        | `int32`   | how many units the output holds, or zero to ask                                        |
| `multiByteStr`    | `*char8`  | the bytes to convert                                                                   |
| `multiByte`       | `int32`   | how many bytes, or -1 to stop at the terminator                                        |
| `defaultChar`     | `*char8`  | the byte to substitute for an unconvertible unit, or null                              |
| `usedDefaultChar` | `*bool32` | receives whether any substitution happened, or null                                    |

**Returns**: the bytes written, the bytes needed when asked, or zero on failure
